views.title: Before the first ball
views.caption: the first firing’s door: a great rosette, its petals open, a band of lapis round its hub; the rules to choose under it

views.name: lapis
views.title: The first firing: lapis
views.caption: cream body, terracotta, a soft ochre glaze and a hard lapis one; a ringed hole, a fan, the next sheet out of focus beyond

views.name: celadon
views.title: The second: celadon
views.caption: porcelain and lilac, a celadon ring round a rosette, oxblood the glaze that takes two

views.name: tenmoku
views.title: The third: tenmoku
views.caption: terracotta and bisque, amber glaze and the black one, crazed; the hand’s ring in cream, its arc of dashes full: a bat

views.name: wide
views.title: On a wider screen
views.caption: the way is the screen’s shape: a wider sheet, more of it

views.name: course
views.title: The course, fired
views.caption: four firings against the clock: the time, the splits against the best, the misses
